certification_limitation: The sealed rehearsal cases are committed and therefore not confidential. Results may validate harness behavior but are not a one-time sealed certification.
confidence_interval_method: deterministic family-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples, percentile 95% interval
sample_size_rationale: Five validation and ten rehearsal families, each with five behavior probes. Inference is clustered by family; cases within a family are not treated as independent.
